spec2def(cryptnet.dll cryptnet.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# cryptnet.dll is all Rust (cryptnet-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cryptnet-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# cryptnet_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cryptnet-rust/src/cryptnet/cryptnet_main.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(cryptnet_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(cryptnet_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register libcrypt32 libshell32 libshlwapi libadvapi32 libole32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(cryptnet_shims)
add_cargo_module(cryptnet cryptnet-cargo cryptnet.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE cryptnet-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cryptnet_shims psdk)
